license_note: No LICENSE file ships in the weight repository; the file was deleted in May 2024, so the governing terms are the Mistral AI Non-Production License linked from the model card, news post, and docs page. The MNPL limits all use to testing, research, personal, or evaluation purposes in non-production environments and bars commercial supply, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

access_boundary: This record represents the mistralai/Codestral-22B-v0.1 weight release of May 2024 at Hugging Face commit 28b1c1a51dabe9d86ca8c41420ada1984632498f (last modified 2025-07-24). Its codestral-2405 API line retired on June 16, 2025. Later Codestral lines, other Mistral code models, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 22B coding checkpoint with tokenizer, params, and fill-in-the-middle support
Release, retirement, and replacement all dated across first-party card, news, and docs
tradeoffs: Non-production-only grant bars any commercial use without a separate Mistral license
The managed API is retired, leaving self-operation as the supported path
